summary: st-test keeps its cargo inside a seat's lane, however st-test was started

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: A check st-test runs in place in a build cap now runs with BUILDS_SLICE_ACTIVE=1; which checks run in place is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Signed notes are unchanged: the recorded command and environment fingerprint do not include the variable. A host whose cargo front door reads the variable keeps cargo in the lane instead of moving it to builds.slice.

downtime.detail: Takes effect on the next st-test run; nothing runs on a member.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure. A seat starting other jobs as units in its lane passes the lane's variables itself (docs/st3/seat-lanes.md).

recovery.detail: Reverting lets a cargo front door move an st-test run's cargo started as a unit in a lane into builds.slice again.
